title: Asmad/yuṣmad full cases and post-pada clitics

ownership.gender: ALINGA under K7.2.90; no M/F/N triplication

ownership.guards: same sentence, after a preceding pada, not metrical-pada initial; 8.1.24 direct ca/vā/ha/aha/eva and 8.1.25 non-visual cognition exclusions retained

accepted_alternatives: tvā/mā, vām/nau, vaḥ/naḥ and te/me only at their exact accusative/dative/genitive number addresses under the inherited eligible post-pada domain
full independent forms remain available when a clitic guard blocks replacement
